author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: অনুচ্ছেদটি পড়ে সঠিক উত্তরটি বেছে নাও (Board: reading MCQ)।

items.passage: The horse is a faithful animal. It has four legs, two ears and a long tail. It is very strong and can run fast. In the past, horses were used in war. Even today they are used to pull carts and carry riders.

subs.q: What kind of animal is the horse?
How does the horse run?
In the past, horses were used in ___.
What are horses used for today?
subs.rule_bn: 'used to pull carts and carry riders'।

items.passage: The tiger is a wild and fierce animal. It lives in deep forests. Its body is yellow with black stripes. It is very strong and hunts other animals for food. The Royal Bengal Tiger of the Sundarbans is famous all over the world.

subs.q: What kind of animal is the tiger?
Where does the tiger live?
What is the colour of the tiger's body?
Which tiger is famous worldwide?

items.passage: The moon is a beautiful object in the night sky. It has no light of its own. It shines by the light of the sun. The moon looks bigger than the stars because it is nearer to the earth. On a full-moon night it lights up the whole world.

subs.q: When can we see the moon?
subs.rule_bn: 'a beautiful object in the night sky'।

subs.q: Does the moon have light of its own?
subs.rule_bn: 'It has no light of its own'।

subs.q: By whose light does the moon shine?
subs.rule_bn: 'shines by the light of the sun'।

subs.q: Why does the moon look bigger than the stars?
opts: it is nearer to the earth
subs.rule_bn: 'because it is nearer to the earth'।

items.passage: The computer is a wonderful machine. It can do many kinds of work very fast. It can store a huge amount of information. Students use it for their studies, and offices use it for their work. The computer has made our life easy.

subs.q: What kind of machine is the computer?
How does the computer do work?
subs.rule_bn: 'do many kinds of work very fast'।

subs.q: What can the computer store?
What has the computer made our life?

items.passage: The peacock is the most beautiful bird. It has a long neck and colourful feathers. When it dances, it spreads its feathers like a fan. It dances mostly in the rainy season. The peacock is the national bird of India.

subs.q: What is the peacock famous for?
What does it spread when it dances?
When does the peacock dance mostly?
The peacock is the national bird of ___.

items.passage: The rose is the queen of flowers. It is loved for its beauty and sweet smell. Roses are of many colours, such as red, white and yellow. The rose plant has thorns on its stem. People grow roses in their gardens.

subs.q: The rose is the queen of ___.
Why is the rose loved?
opts: for its beauty and sweet smell
subs.rule_bn: 'loved for its beauty and sweet smell'।

subs.q: What does the rose plant have on its stem?
Where do people grow roses?

items.passage: Cox's Bazar is the longest sea beach in the world. It is situated in the south-eastern part of Bangladesh. Thousands of tourists visit it every year. They enjoy the beauty of the sea and the golden sand. The sunrise and sunset over the sea are wonderful sights.

subs.q: What is Cox's Bazar?
subs.rule_bn: 'the longest sea beach in the world'।

subs.q: Where is it situated?
Who visit it every year?
What are wonderful sights there?
opts: the sunrise and sunset over the sea
subs.rule_bn: 'The sunrise and sunset over the sea are wonderful'।

items.passage: The dog is a faithful animal. It is a pet animal and lives with man. It guards our house at night. It can smell and hear very well. A dog loves its master and never leaves him. That is why it is called man's best friend.

subs.q: What kind of animal is the dog?
What does the dog do at night?
What can a dog do very well?
The dog is called man's ___.

items.passage: Bangladesh is a small but beautiful country. It is a land of rivers. It has six seasons. The people of Bangladesh are simple and hospitable. Most of them live in villages and work in the fields. Bangladesh won its independence in 1971.

subs.q: Bangladesh is a land of ___.
How many seasons does Bangladesh have?
How are the people of Bangladesh?
When did Bangladesh win independence?

items.passage: The parrot is a beautiful bird. It is green in colour and has a red curved beak. It can imitate human voice. People keep parrots in cages as pets. It eats fruits, seeds and green chillies.

subs.q: What is the colour of the parrot?
What can the parrot imitate?
Where do people keep parrots?
What does the parrot eat?

items.passage: A village fair is a part of our rural culture. It is held on special occasions in an open field. Many things such as toys, sweets and household goods are sold there. People of all ages enjoy the fair. Jatra and other entertainments are also arranged.

subs.q: A village fair is a part of our ___.
Where is the fair held?
What is sold in the fair?
subs.rule_bn: 'toys, sweets and household goods are sold'।

subs.q: What entertainment is arranged?
subs.rule_bn: 'Jatra and other entertainments are also arranged'।

items.passage: The banana is a common fruit of Bangladesh. It grows almost all the year round. It is sweet and full of food value. Banana trees grow in the villages. Both ripe and green bananas are eaten. It is a cheap and useful fruit.

subs.q: When does the banana grow?
How is the banana?
opts: sweet and full of food value

subs.q: Where do banana trees grow?
Which bananas are eaten?
subs.rule_bn: 'Both ripe and green bananas are eaten'।

items.passage: A doctor is a very useful person in society. He treats the sick and saves lives. He works day and night to serve the patients. A good doctor is kind and sincere to all. In villages a good doctor is greatly needed.

subs.q: What does a doctor do?
opts: treats the sick and saves lives

subs.q: When does he work to serve patients?
How is a good doctor?
Where is a good doctor greatly needed?
subs.rule_bn: 'In villages a good doctor is greatly needed'।

items.passage: The river Padma is a big river of Bangladesh. It gives us fish and water. Farmers use its water for cultivation. Boats and ships sail on it. But sometimes the Padma causes floods and takes away houses by erosion.

subs.q: What kind of river is the Padma?
What does the Padma give us?
What do farmers use its water for?
What does the Padma sometimes cause?
subs.rule_bn: 'causes floods and takes away houses by erosion'।

items.passage: Milk is a complete food. It contains all the elements that our body needs. It is good for people of all ages, especially for children and the sick. We get milk from cows and goats. We should drink milk every day.

subs.q: What kind of food is milk?
What does milk contain?
opts: all the elements our body needs
subs.rule_bn: 'contains all the elements that our body needs'।

subs.q: For whom is milk especially good?
From where do we get milk?

items.passage: Football is a popular game all over the world. It is played between two teams. Each team has eleven players. The players try to put the ball into the other team's goal. The team that scores more goals wins the game.

subs.q: How popular is football?
Between how many teams is it played?
How many players are there in each team?
Which team wins the game?
opts: the team that scores more goals
subs.rule_bn: 'The team that scores more goals wins'।
